headline: Uganda Inflation Rises to 3-Year High Following Currency Slump
summary: Uganda's inflation rate climbed to a three-year high following a depreciation of the local currency.
why: Currency depreciation increases the cost of imported goods, directly translating into broader domestic inflation pressures and potentially prompting central bank monetary tightening.

impacts.name: Uganda
impacts.why: A weaker currency drives up import costs, accelerating headline inflation figures.
